title: I Returned the Expired Bike-Shop Hold Ticket With the Promise Date Circled

parts.text: I brought ticket 441 at 4:19 p.m. with Tuesday circled and the wheel still on the back rack. Desk lead Corin said holds were vibes. I was thirty-one, commuter, holding a promise date in red. I photographed the ticket, the circle, and the wheel with my tag. Then I asked for the hold log. Corin found Tuesday in the book and not on the floor. I left the photo with the circled date. The wheel came off the rack into a labeled bay. Corin writes dates now. The shop finally looks like a ticket, not a vibe. I have learned the difference between a title and a line item.
